correctness.rationale: Substitution of the stated positive parameters into the printed constant-R payoff differences gives G=(2yz-1/2,2x+z-3/2,2x+y-3/2), vanishing at (1/2,1/2,1/2). The bracket derivative [[0,1,1],[2,0,1],[2,1,0]] has determinant 4, so the implicit function theorem supplies an open parameter neighborhood of interior equilibria. Multiplication by the positive diagonal factor 1/4 gives eigenvalues -1/4,(1±sqrt(17))/8 and hence a hyperbolic saddle. At every interior equilibrium payoff differences vanish and are each independent of own strategy, so Jacobian diagonal and trace are zero; a hyperbolic trace-zero equilibrium must have positive and negative real parts. Independent rational-symbolic determinant and characteristic polynomial checks agree.
